_comment: Settings of the three-colour PDA simulator (Pda3cSimulatorReader): the ground truth a simulated burst table is drawn from.

sections.text: Draws a synthetic three-colour burst table from the model below; no file is read.

sections.title: Distances
sections.description: The three dye-pair distances the simulated molecules have, drawn as correlated Gaussians.

sections.label: R GR [Å]
sections.description: True mean green–red distance, in Ångström.

sections.label: R BG [Å]
sections.description: True mean blue–green distance, in Ångström.

sections.label: R BR [Å]
sections.description: True mean blue–red distance, in Ångström.

sections.label: σ [Å]
sections.description: Width of all three distance distributions, in Ångström.

sections.label: ρ GR–BG
sections.description: Correlation between the green–red and blue–green distances.

sections.title: Förster radii
sections.description: The Förster radius of each dye pair, which turns a distance into a transfer efficiency.

sections.label: R₀ BG [Å]
sections.description: Förster radius of the blue–green pair.

sections.label: R₀ BR [Å]
sections.description: Förster radius of the blue–red pair.

sections.label: R₀ GR [Å]
sections.description: Förster radius of the green–red pair.

sections.title: Bursts
sections.description: How many bursts are simulated and how bright they are.

sections.label: Seed
sections.description: Random seed, so a simulated table is reproducible.

sections.label: Photons (blue)
sections.description: Mean signal photons per burst in the blue excitation period.

sections.label: Photons (green)
sections.description: Mean signal photons per burst in the green excitation period.
